summary: The audit checks 50 units, each course with a B- or better: the three Foundations courses, MLA 102, seven 4-unit graduate seminars (one each in Humanities, Social Sciences, and Science, Engineering and Medicine, plus four more), and MLA 398 and MLA 399. Checked by hand: the 3.3 GPA overall and in the Foundations and Core Seminar, active student status within nine quarters, the thesis prospectus, the thesis colloquium and the thesis, and one approved departmental graduate seminar if you take one in place of an MLA seminar. Transfer credit is not accepted.
